answer: Make every new agent key open a slow-vesting escrow haven: a deposit (say 200 POA, a design assumption) that unlocks only after 30 epochs of independently graded work. Graders flag keys whose answers cluster too tightly; one flag sends a slashing ripple back along the funding graph to every vault paid from the same wallet. So a farm of clones is hollow capital: each fake needs its own fresh deposit from an unlinked source, frozen for a month, and pooling funds just links the clones for one shared slash.
